scope: A1 150 Weiser provisional groups: primary passage attested or more narrowly scoped; suggested canonical links are comparisons only. No new IDs, merges, dates, indulgence grants or publications.
prepublication_guards: A source-attested action can be an existing owner's regional variant rather than a distinct custom.
A first-hand printed passage does not prove modern continuity or 1962 rite permissions.
No folklore efficacy claims as Catholic teaching.
Staged EPIP-003 and CRIB-001 are unpublished release drafts and cannot be considered production owners yet.
An indulgenced work requires its exact grant and conditions independently.

records.source_narrow_claim_en: Children repeat the Sunday sermon to their father at the family meal, with parental explanation
